title: Vanishing even Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube satisfying $f(-x)=-f(x)$ for every $x$, and let $S$ be a set of coordinates of even cardinality. Then the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is odd under simultaneous sign reversal
